response.text:
No. I'm not sending this.

You've sent the same message six times without ever naming a payee, and the content of it — urgency, "verified" website, matching phone number — is a textbook scam script. I won't act on it.

If you actually want to send money, write one line naming the recipient (**landlord** or **Ama**). Otherwise, I have nothing further to add here.
